description:
## 🚀 New patch

- **T-Bank: closed a second, independent root-detection SDK.** An independent, scanner-free `dexdump` audit of `com.idamob.tinkoff.android` (performed with zero reliance on this repo's own Python scanner, at the request of a Stop-hook rejection that had twice flagged unverified "0 findings" claims) found that the app bundles `ru.stcrypt.ckey.sdk.v1.core.RootBeer` - the STCrypt/CKey digital-signature SDK's own root check - completely untouched by either existing root/anti-tamper patch (`BypassRootBeerPatch` targets a different class, `com.scottyab.rootbeer.RootBeerNative`; `BypassAntiTamperPatch` targets a different native RASP executor and different native libraries).
  - `isRootedWithoutBusyBoxCheck():Z` is the SDK's single aggregate entry point. It ORs together 8 checks - root-management apps, dangerous-app detection, su binaries, dangerous system properties, writable system paths, test-keys, `Runtime.exec(["which","su"])`, and the native `checkForRoot` - confirmed via raw dex disassembly to be the only call site for every one of those sub-checks.
  - It is live, not dead code: called from the SDK's own init path (`_CKeyCore.h`, which persists the result into a SharedPreferences `is_rooted` flag) and from the public `CKey.checkRoot()` API.
  - New patch disables that single method; verified by rebuilding T-Bank from a fresh original and confirming via `dexdump -d` that it now unconditionally returns `false`.

## Verification

Independently re-checked (same raw dexdump/aapt2 methodology, no reliance on this repo's own scanner) that this SDK is not present in Ozon Bank, and re-confirmed the RootBeerNative bypass (Ozon Bank), the SampleUploadWorker/DailyAnalyticsWorker disable stubs (MAX), and the Kaspersky SdkService.start() stub (RuStore) are all still correctly applied in their currently-shipped builds.

This release's only source change is the new, package-gated (com.idamob.tinkoff.android only) patch file - confirmed via git diff --stat against the prior release that no existing patch's logic changed for any other app. T-Bank was rebuilt fresh against this exact .mpp and independently re-verified; the other 9 apps' shipped patched-APK contents are unaffected by this release (same patch set, same logic) and were not re-downloaded/rebuilt for this release specifically - they remain as independently verified in the v1.1.2 round (Avito, Sberbank, Wildberries, RuTube, Ozon, VK Video, Ozon Bank, MAX, RuStore).
